name: feature_groupcv_v1
purpose: Check on train-internal held-out association groups whether window-statistics GBT and M0+GBT average beat M0, without reusing source val for the decision.

arms.M0: frozen M0 B training (protocol causal_pure_mstca_m0_v1, seed 42, same anchor, sampler formula, budget, draws per epoch = number of fold-train windows). Train on 2 folds; checkpoint selection on full source val (unchanged M0 rule); predict held-out fold.
arms.GBT: 130 window statistics (per channel mean, std, min, max, mean |diff|); HistGradientBoosting max_iter 400, lr 0.05, max_leaf_nodes 31, l2 1.0, random_state 0; M0-equivalent Balanced weights with normal mass = fold-train normal count. No val use.
arms.ENS: mean of M0 and GBT fault probabilities

primary_comparison: ENS vs M0 and GBT vs M0, per held-out fold

pass_rule.a: all-normal FP lower than M0 in all 3 folds
pass_rule.b: fault TP >= M0 TP - 0.5% of fold fault windows in all 3 folds
pass_rule.c: independent-normal hover >30s FP lower than M0 in pooled held-out (sum over folds)
pass_rule.d: pooled per-class fault recall drop <= 1.0 pp for each of six classes
pass_rule.verdict: candidate passes if a, b, c and d all hold

then: If ENS or GBT passes, build the neural M0+statistics-branch model under a separately frozen protocol. If neither passes, report and stop this branch.
forbidden: changing GBT hyperparameters or fusion after seeing held-out results
